answer: 1,188 units on hand in warehouse stock locations: 1,098 in WH/Stock and 90 in WH/Stock/Shelf 2. Every product is measured in Units.

answer: USD 527,720.50 at product cost price. Caveat: 207 of the 1,188 units (5 product variants: two Customizable Desk variants, two Conference Chair variants and Acoustic Bloc Screens) have no cost price set, so they add 0.
how_calculated: SUM(quant.quantity * product_product.standard_price for company 1) over internal-location quants gives 527,720.50. I checked it by summing the 13 costed lines by hand (e.g. Large Cabinet 500 x 800 = 400,000), which gave the same total. Company currency is USD.
assumptions: 'Cost price' means the product's standard_price. stock_valuation_layer only has 2 rows (both valued 0) and does not cover all stock, so it was not used. Uncosted items count as 0, so the true value is understated by whatever those 207 units cost.
